description: Sampling root is cross-cutting only. Method-specific sampler knobs (Radius, Point number, Seed, AdaptiveBridson targets, CSV path, dynesty/MCMC kwargs, ...) live exclusively under Bounds.

Mapper.description: Optional pure u->physical reparameterization after Variables[].distribution (D22). Ordered list of {name, expression}. Omitted -> distribution-only mapping (backward compatible). Expressions see Variables and prior Mapper names only (closed namespace). List form keeps schema keys fixed (name/expression) instead of user symbols as object keys.
Mapper.x-jarvis-example:
Mapper:
  - name: x
    expression: "cos(t)"
  - name: y
    expression: "sin(t)"
